answer: At claim, require manufacturer-signed activation of an unused device serial. The registry verifies the signature, consumes one serial nullifier, and permits one key per unit. Proposed verification fee, not a current protocol rule: /bin/bash.75 per unit. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.75 once; 1,000 fake identities need distinct units and pay 50 in verification fees (1,000 × /bin/bash.75), excluding device costs. Bind each receipt to an oasis/shale/quill nonce. Limitation: attackers can buy devices, and maker collusion or unequal access weakens uniqueness.
